latin: Demonstratio septimi Physicorum, quod omne quod mouetur_mouetur ab alio, est demonstratio signi et nullo modo causae.

translation: The demonstration in the seventh book of the Physics, that everything that is moved is moved by another, is a demonstration of the sign and in no way of the cause.
